core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hakeem corresponds to the Arabic form حكيم (Arabic root ح ك م (ḥ-k-m); حكيم (Ḥakīm)). Its core sense is wise, discerning, all-wise. Hakeem is Arabic حكيم (Ḥakīm) 'wise, discerning; all-wise' — an intensive adjective from the root ح ك م and one of the divine names (al-Ḥakīm). The source gloss 'all-knowing' is close but should be 'all-wise' (the 'all-knowing' name is al-ʿAlīm, a different word). Hakeem is also used in South Asia for a physician.
